name: preflight
description: Self-improving code review and development framework. Provides rubric-driven Stage 1 review, Copilot-driven Stage 2 review loops, learning capture, and orchestration for both .NET migration and net-new API development.
_status: WORK-IN-PROGRESS — NOT the live delivery path. This manifest is a roadmap placeholder for future Claude-Code-plugin-form delivery (tracked as the #1 item in docs/v0.2-design.md). The LIVE install path is tools/preflight-install.sh, which copies surfaces into the consumer's .claude/ and merges hook registration directly from hooks/hooks.json into settings.json — it NEVER reads this file. Two keys are deliberately ABSENT until plugin-form is built against verified official Claude Code plugin docs: `hooks` (hook registration; today via hooks/hooks.json -> settings.json) and `agents` (sub-agent registration; today via per-file copy into .claude/agents/). Do NOT assume plugin-form works from this manifest — see docs/v0.2-design.md before enabling it.
